captions.start: Sit tall, back against the chair

steps.text: Sit upright on a chair with your back against it.
Straighten one knee until your leg is level with your hip.
Hold it straight for two seconds.
Lower it slowly. Change legs each time.

safety: Keep your back against the chair.
Use a chair that will not slide.

mistakes.label: no_hold
mistakes.wrong: you did not hold the top position
mistakes.right: Hold the straight leg for 2 seconds before lowering it.

mistakes.label: thigh_lift
mistakes.wrong: your whole thigh lifted off the seat
mistakes.right: Keep your thigh resting on the seat; only the lower leg moves.
